## Description

Switch between momentum and reversion signals based on volatility, trend-strength or market-state filters.

## Where it may fit

FX markets whose state can shift between directional sessions and range-bound periods.

## Vehicles

FX spot, FX futures, currency ETFs and systematic macro portfolios.

## Required data

Intraday/daily FX prices, session/time-zone calendar, carry/swap rates, volatility, costs.

## Caveats

Regime filters can lag; spreads, swaps and weekend gaps matter.
